{"metadata":{"description":"Wakes the main agent after any DSH restart so interrupted work resumes automatically — adds a restart tool and an optional canary that validates the boot and warns instead of breaking.","id":"gh:1338344597","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-smart-restart","slug":"edusrez/dsh-smart-restart","topics":["agent-tools","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","plugin","quality-of-life"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Wakes the main agent after any DSH restart so interrupted work resumes automatically — adds a restar"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"t tool and an optional canary that validates the boot and warns instead of breaking."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-smart-restart"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"*A real-time restart: the agent restarts the service (canary pre-flight passing, `Canary: passed — r"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"estarting…`), and the plugin's boot notification brings the very same session right back — the conve"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"rsation continues automatically, no user prompt needed.*"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"A **DeepSeek Harness (DSH) host plugin** that keeps the main agent aware of service restarts — **wit"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"hout the user having to prompt it**. On every boot it detects that a new process has taken over, wak"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"es the target agent with a short "Smart-restart" notice (boot time, previous boot, downtime). New in"},{"id":"p5s4","text":" **v0.2.0** it added the `smart_restart` tool to **restart DSH itself** and return the notice to the"},{"id":"p5s5","text":" exact session that asked; new in **v0.3.0** it **auto-detects** when the service was stopped while "},{"id":"p5s6","text":"an agent session was active, so even a *plain* `systemctl restart` the agent ran notifies that sessi"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"on at boot; new in **v0.4.0** it can **validate the launch first** with an optional canary pre-resta"},{"id":"p5s8","text":"rt gate that aborts the restart when an ephemeral boot fails. New in **v0.5.0** it **auto-detects th"},{"id":"p5s9","text":"e systemd unit** from `/proc/self/cgroup`, so the tool and the canary work with zero config on syste"},{"id":"p5s10","text":"md-managed installs."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Overview"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"A long-lived DSH instance restarts for many reasons: the agent installs or reconfigures a plugin and"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" triggers a reboot, the host machine reboots, or the service is restarted under **systemd**. After a"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ny such restart the agent is up and running again, but it has **no idea that anything happened** — t"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"he previous session is gone. Today, the only way to get the agent to pick back up is for the user to"},{"id":"p7s5","text":" tell it, usually with something like *"you restarted"*."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"`dsh-smart-restart` closes that gap. It detects the restart itself and wakes the main agent at boot "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"with a short, self-contained notice describing what happened, so the agent decides whether to resume"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" interrupted work, note the downtime, or simply acknowledge — no user prompt needed."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**New in v0.3.0**, the plugin also covers the *unplanned* restart of an **active agent**. It tracks "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"the last active session and, on shutdown (`SIGTERM`/`SIGINT`), persists a `shutdown-notice.json`; on"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" boot it pins the notice back to that session (when it was active within `shutdownGraceMs`). So a pl"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ain `systemctl restart` the agent ran — or a restart that happened while an agent was mid-task — is "},{"id":"p9s5","text":"auto-notified without the user prompting. v0.2.0 let the main agent *cause* restarts: the `smart_res"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"tart` tool records the calling session and restarts DSH through systemd, returning the notice to tha"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"ds the calling session and restarts DSH through systemd, returning the notice to that exact session."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Zero prompting** — the user never has to tell the agent "you restarted".
- **Self-restart** — th"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"e main agent can restart DSH itself and resume its task automatically afterwards.
- **Automatic wake"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"** — an idle main agent is woken and handed the notice on its own.
- **Targeted delivery** — the pos"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"t-restart notice returns to the session that requested it; otherwise the `target` config decides whe"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"re it lands.
- **Read-before-edit guard** — `smart_restart` reads the LIVE agent registry and refuse"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"s to restart while other sessions are mid-turn (unless `force: true`), so a blind interruption is st"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"ructurally impossible.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"On every boot the plugin:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"1. **Reads the previous marker** — a durable `marker.json` (`{lastBootAt, pid, dshVersion?}`) stored"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" under `<DSH_HOME>/<stateDir>/`.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **DSH `0.1.0-rc.7+` / `0.1.1-rc.x`** — a **long-lived instance with a live main-agent session** (t"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"he web / GUI profile). This plugin is designed for a continuously-running service whose main agent s"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"tays resident; it is **not** aimed at the one-shot headless CLI.
- **systemd-managed DSH install** f"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"or the `smart_restart` tool — v0.5.0 auto-detects the service unit from `/proc/self/cgroup`; set `re"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"startUnit` explicitly when the unit differs or on non-systemd (where the tool fails safe).
- **Node."},{"id":"p15s6","text":"js / pnpm** — the usual DSH toolchain for building and installing host bundles."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Be honest about what this plugin does not do:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **Agent-side awareness only.** There is no desktop or browser toast — DSH currently has no notific"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ation service, so the notice surfaces only in the agent's own context (visible in the GUI session, n"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"ot as an OS/browser notification).
- **Not for the one-shot headless CLI.** A boot-time wake may not"},{"id":"p18s4","text":" exit cleanly in a single-shot headless run; this plugin targets long-lived GUI instances. The notic"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"e is still delivered and committed, but for headless one-shots it is of little use.
- **Per-DSH-home"},{"id":"p18s6","text":" marker.** The marker lives under a single `<DSH_HOME>`, so separate homes (e.g. your stable vs. dev"},{"id":"p18s7","text":" instance) are tracked independently — a restart of one does not notify agents in the other.
- **Too"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"l requires a systemd unit.** Since **v0.5.0** the `smart_restart` tool **auto-detects the plugin's o"},{"id":"p18s9","text":"wn unit from `/proc/self/cgroup`** on systemd-managed installs — no `restartUnit` config needed. On "},{"id":"p18s10","text":"a host where no unit is detectable (a bare non-systemd process), the tool still fails safe: set `res"},{"id":"p18s11","text":"tartUnit` explicitly to override the auto-detected unit or to enable the tool there. Non-tool restar"},{"id":"p18s12","text":"ts are still auto-detected when an agent was active within `shutdownGraceMs`, otherwise they fall ba"},{"id":"p18s13","text":"ck to `target`.
- **Canary adds latency.** A canary-gated call blocks the tool for up to `canaryTime"},{"id":"p18s14","text":"outMs` (default 45s) while the ephemeral instance boots and is probed; disable the canary (or lower "},{"id":"p18s15","text":"the timeout) for fast, low-risk restarts. The canary validates config/compose + boot health, not the"},{"id":"p18s16","text":" `systemctl restart` command itself (the restart remains fire-and-forget).
- **Existing sessions may"},{"id":"p18s17","text":" lack the tool.** A session whose toolset was created **before** the plugin was installed won't have"},{"id":"p18s18","text":" `smart_restart` — start a new chat after installing to pick it up.
- **rc-era API.** The plugin tar"},{"id":"p18s19","text":"gets DSH `0.1.0-rc.7+` / `0.1.1-rc.x`; pre-1.0 APIs (events, session ids, message forms) may change "},{"id":"p18s20","text":".7+` / `0.1.1-rc.x`; pre-1.0 APIs (events, session ids, message forms) may change in later releases."}],"truncated":true}
